---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or improvement
title: '[feat] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Use case

What workflow are you trying to support? What can you not do today?

## Plan alignment

- Owning phase in `docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md`:
- Prerequisite gate already passed:
- Product priority served (integrity, sound, ease of use, advanced, AI, external):

## Proposal

How might it work? Sketch the UI or API if useful.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why they fall short.

## Acceptance and cost

How will this be tested or measured? Note project-format, command, audio,
accessibility, performance, security, provider-cost, and migration impact.

Features outside the currently open phase will normally remain parked until their
prerequisites pass.

## Additional context

Links to similar features elsewhere, references, etc.
